prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in League City, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1345; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in on the roadway in League City, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please describe in your own words what happened leading up to the collision.

A: I was stopped at a red light in the right lane. The traffic had been moving slowly, and then I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped forward and then back.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt at the time?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you notice the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I was looking ahead at the light. I only saw it in my mirror right before it hit me.

Q: After the collision, did you get out of your vehicle?

A: I did, but I felt stiff. My neck was sore right away, and my lower back started aching within an hour or so.

Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that afternoon. They diagnosed me with a neck and back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and some physical therapy referrals.

Q: Are you currently receiving treatment?

A: Yes, I'm going to physical therapy twice a week. I still have trouble turning my head to the left and sitting for long periods.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I've been missing some work because of the pain, and I'm hoping this gets resolved soon.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
